credentials.description: Current factory SSH reference for an unconfigured UniFi OS Console. After setup, use credentials configured by the owner.
credentials.warning: Use only on an authorized, unconfigured device. Complete setup and replace factory access immediately.

credentials.description: Current factory SSH reference for an unconfigured UniFi Gateway. Adopted gateways use owner-configured credentials.
credentials.warning: Use only on an authorized, unconfigured gateway. Replace factory access during setup.

credentials.description: Current factory SSH reference for unadopted UniFi devices such as access points and switches. Adopted devices use credentials configured in UniFi Network.
credentials.warning: Use only on an authorized, unadopted device. Adopt it and configure unique SSH credentials.

credentials.description: Legacy factory SSH reference documented for older UniFi Consoles and Gateways before setup.
credentials.warning: Confirm the exact legacy model and ownership. Replace factory access immediately.

credentials.description: Legacy factory SSH reference documented for older unadopted UniFi access points and switches.
credentials.warning: Confirm the exact legacy model and ownership. Adopt it and replace factory credentials.

credentials.product: RouterOS devices shipped without a factory password
credentials.description: Some RouterOS devices initially use admin with an empty password. Other models have a unique password on a sticker.
credentials.warning: Check the device label first. Connect only on a trusted local network, then set a unique password immediately.

credentials.product: RouterOS devices with factory password label
credentials.description: Some RouterOS models use admin with a unique factory password printed on the product label or packaging.
credentials.warning: Read the password from the physical device or packaging. SSH It never guesses it.

credentials.description: FortiOS documents the initial FortiGate administrator as admin with no password. Exact platform and cloud-image onboarding can differ.
credentials.warning: Verify model documentation. Fortinet requires setting a password at first login; do that immediately.

credentials.description: Product-specific initial credential for Catalyst 1200 and 1300 switches. It is not a universal Cisco IOS or IOS XE default.
credentials.warning: Use only on the matching authorized switch. First login requires replacing both default username and password.

credentials.description: Product-specific initial credential for Cisco 500 Series switches. It does not apply to every Cisco device.
credentials.warning: Use only on the matching authorized switch and replace the default credential at first login.

credentials.description: FortiSwitchOS provides admin with no password and forces a replacement on first GUI or CLI login.
credentials.warning: Use only on an authorized factory-reset standalone switch and set a strong password during first login.

credentials.product: FortiManager appliance or VM after factory reset
credentials.description: FortiManager ships with admin and a blank password, then requires a password change during first login.
credentials.warning: Use only on an authorized new or factory-reset manager and set a unique password immediately.

credentials.product: FortiAnalyzer appliance or VM after factory reset
credentials.description: FortiAnalyzer factory login is admin with no password; current versions prompt for a compliant replacement.
credentials.warning: Use only on an authorized new or reset analyzer and replace blank access immediately.

credentials.description: FortiWeb factory configuration provides admin with a blank password and forces a change at first login.
credentials.warning: Use only on an authorized factory-reset FortiWeb and replace blank access before connecting production networks.

credentials.product: FortiADC-VM first login on IBM Cloud
credentials.description: The official IBM Cloud guide specifies admin with an empty initial password for FortiADC GUI or SSH access.
credentials.warning: Scope is the IBM Cloud image. Update the password at first login and verify other deployment platforms separately.

credentials.product: Cisco Business CBS250 and CBS350 switches
credentials.description: CBS250 and CBS350 documentation specifies cisco for username and password on first CLI login, including SSH mode.
credentials.warning: Use only on a matching authorized CBS switch; the first login requires new credentials.

credentials.product: Catalyst 3850 before IOS XE Fuji 16.9.x WebUI setup
credentials.description: Cisco documents webui with the chassis serial number as the initial credential before Fuji 16.9.x.
credentials.warning: Confirm model and software release, then obtain the serial number from the authorized asset record or chassis.

credentials.description: AOS-CX factory defaults include admin with an empty password and management access including SSH.
credentials.warning: Set a strong admin password during initial boot before placing the switch on a production management network.

credentials.description: OS10 preloads the sysadmin-role CLI account admin with password admin and supports it over SSH.
credentials.warning: Replace the password after first login or create a new sysadmin and remove the default admin account.

credentials.product: SmartFabric OS10 Linux shell factory account
credentials.description: OS10 preloads linuxadmin for its Linux shell and SFTP, with the same initial password.
credentials.warning: Use only on matching OS10 switches and change or disable the Linux shell account after setup.

credentials.product: Current iDRAC systems with secure default password
credentials.description: Current Dell servers normally ship with a unique iDRAC root password on the system information tag.
credentials.warning: Read the authorized service tag label; never substitute the legacy shared password unless the order retained it.

credentials.product: iDRAC systems ordered with legacy default password
credentials.description: Dell allows systems to retain the legacy iDRAC root password calvin as an explicit order option.
credentials.warning: Do not try this on arbitrary current servers. Confirm the legacy order option, then replace it.

credentials.description: XClarity Controller specifies USERID and PASSW0RD, using a zero in the password, for the initial supervisor.
credentials.warning: Use only on an authorized unconfigured controller and replace the initial supervisor credential immediately.

credentials.product: Supermicro BMC systems manufactured since late 2019
credentials.description: Current Supermicro systems use ADMIN with a unique password printed on the motherboard or chassis label.
credentials.warning: Read the physical label. Supermicro stopped using the shared ADMIN password on affected new systems.

credentials.product: Legacy Supermicro IPMI and BMC hardware
credentials.description: Legacy Supermicro IPMI documentation used ADMIN for both ID and password before unique-password rollout.
credentials.warning: Confirm legacy manufacture date and platform. Do not use this on current systems; replace it if present.

credentials.description: iLO 5 uses Administrator with a factory-defined password printed on the server serial-label pull tab.
credentials.warning: Read the authorized server label and change the initial iLO credential after first login.

credentials.description: ExtremeXOS factory defaults include an administrator account with no assigned password.
credentials.warning: Use only during authorized initial setup and assign a strong password before enabling remote management.

credentials.description: ExtremeXOS factory defaults also include a read-only user account with no assigned password.
credentials.warning: Use only on an authorized factory-default switch and secure or disable the account during setup.

credentials.description: VOSS normal security mode documents matching username and password for read-write-all access.
credentials.warning: Enhanced secure mode differs. Confirm security mode and replace all matching shared credentials immediately.

credentials.description: VOSS normal security mode documents rw for both username and password at the read-write level.
credentials.warning: Enhanced secure mode differs. Confirm device mode and change the shared default after first login.

credentials.description: VOSS normal security mode documents ro for both username and password at the read-only level.
credentials.warning: Enhanced secure mode differs. Confirm device mode and change or disable the shared default.

credentials.description: VOSS normal security mode documents l1 for both username and password at the Layer 1 role.
credentials.warning: Enhanced secure mode differs. Use only on an authorized matching switch and change the default.

credentials.description: VOSS normal security mode documents l2 for both username and password at the Layer 2 role.
credentials.warning: Enhanced secure mode differs. Use only on an authorized matching switch and change the default.

credentials.description: VOSS normal security mode documents l3 for both username and password at the Layer 3 role.
credentials.warning: Enhanced secure mode differs. Use only on an authorized matching switch and change the default.

credentials.description: pfSense documents admin and pfsense as factory credentials; Plus 24.03 and later forces replacement.
credentials.warning: SSH is disabled by default. Enable only on a trusted management network and replace the password immediately.

credentials.product: pfSense SSH root alias for factory administrator
credentials.description: When SSH password authentication is enabled, pfSense allows root to use the admin account credential.
credentials.warning: SSH is disabled by default. Restrict it to trusted hosts and replace the factory admin password before use.

credentials.description: OPNsense documents root and opnsense after fresh installation unless a previous configuration was imported.
credentials.warning: Use only on a fresh authorized firewall and set a unique root password during initial configuration.

credentials.product: OPNsense live installation environment installer account
credentials.description: The OPNsense live image exposes installer with password opnsense for installation, including SSH.
credentials.warning: Scope is booted installation media, not a configured production firewall. Replace credentials after installation.

credentials.product: PA-Series and VM-Series firewall first login
credentials.description: PAN-OS documents admin for both username and initial password; PAN-OS 9.0.4 and later forces a change.
credentials.warning: Use only through the authorized management interface during setup and replace the default immediately.

credentials.description: Panorama M-Series appliances use admin and admin before initial configuration and mandatory replacement.
credentials.warning: Use only on an authorized new or reset Panorama appliance and replace the credential before deployment.

credentials.description: SonicOS 6.5 specifies admin and password for factory management; admin is used for SSH CLI access.
credentials.warning: Confirm SonicOS generation and ownership. Run initial setup and replace the shared password before exposure.

credentials.description: Sophos Firewall ships with super administrator admin/admin for web and CLI console access, including SSH.
credentials.warning: Restrict access to trusted LAN or management ports and change the default immediately after deployment.

credentials.description: Locally managed Firebox appliances include admin with the factory read-write passphrase.
credentials.warning: Use only on an authorized factory-default Firebox and change both built-in passphrases during setup.

credentials.description: Locally managed Firebox appliances include status with the factory read-only passphrase.
credentials.warning: Read-only access exposes operational data. Change the passphrase on every authorized new or reset Firebox.

credentials.description: QTS 5.0 and 5.1 use Adapter 1 MAC without separators and in uppercase as the SSH admin password.
credentials.warning: Obtain MAC1 from the authorized label or Qfinder, then replace the derived password and disable admin when practical.

credentials.description: QTS 5.2 documentation identifies the device Cloud Key as the default admin password.
credentials.warning: Read the Cloud Key from authorized records; never substitute MAC-derived or legacy values across versions.

credentials.product: Citrix ADC hardware and legacy virtual appliance first login
credentials.description: Citrix ADC appliance documentation specifies nsroot for username and initial password for SSH CLI access.
credentials.warning: Current CPX and some workflows generate other defaults. Confirm platform and replace nsroot immediately.

credentials.description: NetScaler CPX generates a password at deployment and applies it to root and nsroot SSH users.
credentials.warning: Retrieve it through the authorized deployment workflow and change it; do not use the appliance shared default.

credentials.product: APC Network Management Card 2 factory super user
credentials.description: APC NMC2 documentation specifies apc for the factory super-user name and password; CLI supports SSH.
credentials.warning: Scope is NMC2. Confirm card generation, use a management network, and replace the default.

credentials.product: M4250, M4300, M4350 and related fully managed switches
credentials.description: NETGEAR documents admin with an empty password for first CLI login on fully managed switch families.
credentials.warning: First login forces a new password. Confirm exact model and do not expose an unconfigured interface.

credentials.product: JetStream T1500 through T3700 managed switches
credentials.description: TP-Link documents admin for both SSH login username and password on listed JetStream families.
credentials.warning: Confirm exact family, log in only on a trusted management network, and change the password immediately.

credentials.description: Cumulus Linux 4.2 and later provide the sudo-enabled cumulus account for SSH and force a change.
credentials.warning: Confirm image version. Complete the forced password change before reconnecting and store it securely.

credentials.description: NVIDIA documents CumulusLinux! as the initial cumulus password for version 4.1.z and earlier.
credentials.warning: Confirm the legacy image version; never try this on current images. Replace it at first login.

credentials.product: Oracle ILOM service processor factory administrator
credentials.description: Oracle ILOM provides root and changeme for first access, with SSH enabled by factory default.
credentials.warning: Use only on an authorized unconfigured service processor and replace changeme during first login.
